_readme: HOMEPAGE CONTENT. 'intro' paragraphs appear under your name. 'themes' are the research themes. 'featuredProject' must match a slug in content/projects/.
intro: I study how emotional and developmental experiences shape cognitive and psychological processes. My interests sit across cognitive and clinical psychology — attention, inhibitory control, emotional processing, and the childhood experiences that underlie later mental health.
My work is mostly experimental and quantitative: reaction-time paradigms, questionnaire research, and careful attention to research method.
_themes: Three or four research themes. Keep each description to one or two sentences.

themes.title: Clinical Psychology
themes.text: Psychological distress, childhood experiences, and the processes that shape mental health across the lifespan.

themes.title: Cognitive Psychology
themes.text: Attention, inhibitory control, working memory, and the ways emotional material interferes with ongoing cognitive performance.

themes.title: Developmental & Environmental Factors
themes.text: How early-life experiences and social environments shape psychological and cognitive functioning later in life.

themes.title: Experimental Psychology
themes.text: Behavioral experimentation, reaction-time paradigms, emotional stimuli, and the quantitative methods used to study them.
